visual.general_description: Three-panel CT figure (A, B axial; C coronal) of the abdomen with yellow arrows marking hypodense lesions; the caption places the abscesses in the liver and spleen.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A is a large axial slice at the left with arrows at a hypodense lesion in the posterior liver and a small hypodense lesion at the posterior spleen. Panel B (upper right inset) is a cropped axial slice of a large solid organ with two arrows at small hypodense foci; the organ is not identified by the caption or labels. Panel C (lower right inset) is a coronal slice of a large solid organ with one arrow at a small hypodense focus near its upper surface. All arrows are yellow; only the panel letters A, B and C are printed. No scale bars, patient names, dates or other burned-in text are visible.

panels.general_description: Axial contrast-enhanced CT slice of the upper abdomen with two yellow arrows.
panels.detailed_description: Large axial slice labelled A at lower left. It shows the liver on the image left, the stomach and bowel anteriorly, the vertebral body and aorta centrally and the spleen on the image right. A yellow arrow at the lower left points to a rounded hypodense area in the posterior liver. A second yellow arrow at the lower right points to a small hypodense area at the posterior splenic margin. No scale bar, measurement or text other than the panel letter is visible.
